title: Elevators, escalators, moving walkways, material lifts, man lifts and dumbwaiters.
officialText:
Elevators, escalators,
moving walkways, material lifts, man lifts and dumbwaiters shall be inspected and tested in accordance with section 28-
304.6, chapter 30 of the New York city building code, and the schedule set forth in Table N1 of ASME A17.1 as modified
by chapter K1 of appendix K of the New York city building code.
